description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing weekend with Maria exploring the trails.

Would you like help turning that into an email (to family, friends, or a group) or saving a short note as a draft? I can:

- Draft a quick “we’re back” message
- Write a longer recap with highlights and photo captions
- Send it now if you give me the recipient(s) and any photos to attach
- Save it as a draft instead

If you want a draft, here are two quick options you can pick or edit:

1) Short version
Subject: Back from a lovely weekend in the countryside
Body: Hi — Maria and I spent the weekend in the countryside exploring nature trails and breathing in fresh air. It was so relaxing — wanted to share a quick hello. Hope you’re well!

2) Longer version
Subject: Weekend in the countryside — highlights + photos
Body: Hi everyone — Maria and I took a short trip to the countryside this weekend. We hiked several peaceful nature trails, saw wildflowers and birds, and just enjoyed the fresh air and quiet. It was a great reset. I attached a few photos from the walk. Thought you might enjoy them — we’ll share more soon!

Which option would you like, and who should I send or save it to? Any photos or specific details to include?
